demoData: Valores, cidades e datas são ilustrativos.
title: Operacional Marketing
prompt: Create a polished high-fidelity desktop web app screenshot mockup, 1600x1000 landscape, for the existing Portuguese GO Itaim internal dashboard, visual direction “Folhas de Operação”. Use the reference style: editorial operations worksheet, warm ivory paper background, deep forest green, muted sage, graphite typography, subtle thin rules, small restrained orange warning accents; clean precise grid, premium data product, no gradients, no glassmorphism, no decorative illustration. Reproduce a realistic browser-free app screen with a persistent dark green left sidebar and white main workspace. Sidebar brand GO Itaim, sections and existing labels: Principal (Visão Geral, Análise, UTR, Comparação), Operacional (Entregadores, Valores, Prioridade | Promo, Evolução, Dedicado), Marketing (Operacional Marketing selected, Marketing); small avatar at bottom. Across top of main area put a compact city/date ticker strip with visible horizontally scrollable pairs: Guarulhos · 14/09, Manaus · 15/09, São Paulo 2.0 · 16/09, Sorocaba · 17/09, plus subtle left/right controls and fade suggesting more cities. Below it show the complete global filter, highly legible in two rows: period mode Ano/Semana selected, Ano 2026, Semanas 05, 06, 07, then Praça Todas, Sub praça Todas, Origem Todas, Turno Todos, Limpar. Main page title “Operacional Marketing”, subtitle “Comparativo semanal de desempenho operacional e marketing”. Content heading “Comparativo Semanal”; top right action “Exportar Excel”. Show three summary cards: Corridas operacionais 12.480, Investimento marketing R$ 38.420, Custo por corrida R$ 3,08. Under the cards, a clear wide data table comparing columns Semana, Praça, Corridas, Verba marketing, Custo por corrida, Variação; rows Sem. 05 Guarulhos, Sem. 06 Manaus, Sem. 07 São Paulo 2.0, Sem. 07 Sorocaba; include small calm sparkline in each row and subtle positive/negative indicators. Add a small right-side trend panel “Corridas x investimento” with two clean lines. Layout should feel dense but readable and faithful to a mature operational analytics app. All visible copy in Brazilian Portuguese, correct spelling, crisp real UI text, no watermark, no invented modules. Numbers and dates are illustrative demo data, not live data.
